notes: Actual eval-mode checkpoint forward passes; no synthetic intermediate frames.
Targets are illustrative next tokens, not an accuracy benchmark.
Attention weights are rounded to six decimal places.
Concentration measures last-query focus, not head importance or causality.
No implicit beginning-of-sequence token; pretrained tokenizer from final checkpoint.
Training steps are sampled at unequal intervals; playback visits recorded checkpoints.

scenes.title: Follow the pattern
scenes.description: The same color sequence appears twice. Track the chance of continuing it with purple, and explore which earlier tokens each head attends to.
scenes.prompt: red blue green yellow orange purple red blue green yellow orange

scenes.title: A familiar beginning
scenes.description: A familiar phrase, seen at different points in training. Watch the probability of time alongside the model's other next-token guesses.

scenes.title: A fact taking shape
scenes.description: An illustrative factual prompt. Follow Paris through training; its probability can rise or fall, and a small model may prefer another completion.
